title: Line Up the Program
story: Chilaka dropped the program lines on the floor. Put them back in an order that works.
goal: Greet the person, then print how many letters are in their name.
starter:
greeting = "Hello, " + name
print(len(name))
name = input()
print(greeting)
hints: A variable must exist before a later line uses it. Which line creates name?
Read first, build the greeting, then print.

name = input()
greeting = "Hello, " + name
print(greeting)
print(len(name))
socratic: Which line must come first, and why?
Which lines need a variable that another line creates?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what decides the order of these lines?
solution:
name = input()
greeting = "Hello, " + name
print(greeting)
print(len(name))
